name: @adatechnology/vehicles-proving-area
description: Vehicle proving ground for the shared test room: a fleet vehicle runs the measured tests of game-vehicles-proving live on a track (0-100, top speed, braking, turning circle, wet braking, mud), with the chase, cockpit and hood cameras of game-camera, the rear-view and side mirrors and the reversing camera as extra views, the certificate board by the track and the sign-off of the visual checks.
